# Introduction

Hex is a community-driven platform for creating, sharing, and discovering Minecraft capes.

![image](data:image/png;base64,)

Built around simplicity and reliability, Hex allows creators to publish capes, generate previews automatically, and share their work through a modern catalog and preview system. Hex supports various minecraft versions throught the [Hex Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/hex-capes) mod which is also avilable on [modrinth](https://modrinth.com)

# Get Started

Use the linked [Installation Guide](installation-guide.md) to set everything up
